suite.name: Gardiner Lab Tools
suite.tagline: Molecular plant biology software for the lab

tools.name: MoClo Library Tool
tools.summary: Browse and manage the lab's Golden Gate parts library, check overhang compatibility, and plan modular assemblies.
points: Parts, cassettes, backbones and assembled plasmids

tools.name: Plasmid Editor
tools.summary: Edit and annotate any plasmid, simulate cloning, and align sequencing reads. For work that is not Golden Gate based.
points: Type directly into the sequence; restriction maps and virtual gels
Golden Gate, Gibson, ligation and recombination simulation

tools.name: Lab Notebook
tools.summary: Your lab notebook: a page for every day, the lab's shared protocols, MoClo reactions and links to plasmids.
points: Start a day; pages, labels and links between them
Protocols with active tables that scale, calculate and tick off
MoClo reactions and plasmid links that open in the editor

admin.name: Dashboard
admin.summary: Accounts, labs and their registration codes, the MoClo library, and backups: every control for every tool, in one place.

admin.name: Backups
admin.summary: Choose where backups are kept, run one now, and restore — or move everything to another machine.

planned.name: Primer database
planned.summary: A shared, searchable record of the lab's oligos and what they were used for.
